IEEEtran 1.8b, released 2015-08-26, maintained by Michael Shell.
Source distribution (retrieved 2026-10-08):
https://ctan.math.illinois.edu/macros/latex/contrib/IEEEtran.zip
Package identity and license:
https://ctan.org/pkg/ieeetran
https://www.latex-project.org/lppl/lppl-1-3.txt

The complete upstream ZIP is included unchanged. The source/IEEEtran.cls copy uses CRLF line endings, whereas IEEEtran/IEEEtran.cls inside that ZIP uses LF. Their contents match after normalizing line endings; they are not byte-identical. All original copyright, contribution, maintenance and legal notices remain present. LPPL 1.3 is supplied verbatim, without modification. Neither the original contributors nor IEEE endorse or support the manuscript or its surrounding build package.
